articles.title: Coldcard reveals how Bitcoin wallet flaw went undetected for over 5 years
articles.snippet: Coldcard maker Coinkite explained why years of security checks failed to catch the flaw and said it has yet to decide on compensation for affected customers.

articles.title: USDT buyers face 22% VAT when Moscow Exchange opens crypto trading
articles.snippet: Buyers will pay VAT on top of the trade price in December because Russia’s tax code has no explicit exemption for foreign digital instruments.

articles.title: Coldcard Bitcoin Exploit, Revisited: How a Hidden Flaw Survived Years of Audits
articles.snippet: Coinkite’s postmortem reveals a software random-number generator shipped in place of the hardware one for over five years, slipping past at least 15 reviews.

articles.title: What Is Pons? The Robinhood Chain Meme Coin Launchpad Explained
articles.snippet: Pons lets anyone launch a fixed-supply token on Robinhood Chain in one transaction. Here's how it works, and what its PONS token does.
